_intro.text: Turn on the TV for setup. Each adapter instance controls one TV.

host.label: TV address
host.help: Enter the TV's IP address or hostname without http:// or a port. A fixed IP address is recommended.
host.validatorErrorText: Enter the TV's IP address or hostname.

pollInterval.label: Update interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: 0 disables automatic status queries, including the initial query at startup. Otherwise, enter 5 to 3600 seconds. Manual commands remain available.
pollInterval.validatorErrorText: Enter 0 or a whole number from 5 to 3600.

maxVolume.label: Maximum volume for direct commands
maxVolume.help: Limits direct volume commands to this TV level. Remote control buttons and changes made on the TV are not limited.

pollPlayback.label: Read current playback
pollPlayback.help: Include current playback in status queries. Disable this if the TV does not support the playback query.

_wakeHelp.text: Wake-on-LAN requires the TV MAC address and network wake-up support on the TV. For the first test from standby, enter the MAC address manually. Automatic detection requires a successful device query while the TV is reachable.

macLan.label: LAN MAC address (optional)
macLan.help: MAC address of the TV's wired network interface, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
macLan.validatorErrorText: Enter a MAC address or leave this field empty.

macWlan.label: Wi-Fi MAC address (optional)
macWlan.help: MAC address of the TV's wireless network interface. Waking up over Wi-Fi depends on the TV.
macWlan.validatorErrorText: Enter a MAC address or leave this field empty.

broadcastAddress.label: Broadcast address
broadcastAddress.help: With 255.255.255.255, the adapter also tries a matching local network broadcast when the TV address is IPv4. A different address entered here is used as specified.
broadcastAddress.validatorErrorText: Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.

_wakeStatusHelp.text: info.wakeReady only shows whether a MAC address is known. It does not confirm that the TV supports Wake-on-LAN. info.lastWakeOnLan records the latest successful packet transmission.

port.label: TV control port
port.help: Leave at 905 unless your TV requires a different port.

timeout.label: Response timeout (milliseconds)
timeout.help: Maximum time to wait for an answer to one TV request.

appendNul.label: Append compatibility byte (NUL)
appendNul.help: Leave enabled to use the request format of Loewe App 1.4.7.

enableAdvanced.label: Enable additional TV commands
enableAdvanced.help: Allows advanced requests, including changes to recordings, favorites and TV settings. Available functions depend on the TV model.
